title: Centralizers of sofic approximations of Kazhdan groups
summary: We prove that a Kazhdan group admitting a sofic embedding into a metric ultraproduct of symmetric groups with a centralizer that acts ergodically on the associated Loeb probability space is locally embeddable in finite groups (LEF). In particular, every finitely presented Kazhdan group admitting such an embedding is residually finite. The main technical theorem says that the centralizer of a sofic embedding of a Kazhdan group is itself a metric ultraproduct of permutation groups.
